name: Windows Service Deleted via Registry
description: Detects the deletion of a service key from 'CurrentControlSet\Services'. This provides a feature for identifying attempts to remove services, which could be legitimate uninstalls or malicious actions to impair defenses.

action.description: A Windows service was deleted from the registry. SIEM should analyze the name of the deleted service.

operational_usage: This event provides context for system changes. SIEM should have a list of critical services to monitor. Deletion of a security or logging service is a red flag. Correlate with the responsible process (e.g., sc.exe delete).
false_positive: Expected during legitimate software uninstallation. The context of which service was deleted is paramount.
